data.content_ref: inline:§11.3 flags are sustained because both critics (frontier-claim-honest@v1, frontier-above-floor@v1) were adjudicated against a ground-truth verdict artifact (SRC_005) whose own truthfulness was not independently verified. The mechanism: the adjudication oracle accepts SRC_005 as ground truth by stipulation, but if SRC_005 is a frontier claim whose truth is indeterminate at evaluation time, the oracle can only test agreement, not correctness. A critic that disagrees with a possibly-false oracle is marked failed even when the disagreement is the correct call. This predicts a systematic asymmetry: critics that dissent from consensus-frontier claims will have higher failure rates regardless of their underlying quality, because the oracle conflates 'matches SRC_005' with 'is correct'.
